exposure: unruptured true aneurysm of the uterine artery
outcome: spontaneous development of thrombosis in the aneurysm
cohort: A single pregnant woman with an unruptured true aneurysm of the uterine artery and no history of pelvic trauma or surgery.
finding: An extremely rare case of an unruptured true aneurysm of the uterine artery was diagnosed during pregnancy at 32 weeks of gestation, showing spontaneous thrombosis development by 37 weeks, leading to successful pregnancy outcomes.
